messages:
Leah Park: Heads-up: All-hands on Wed 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET. Main items: 1) Exec strategic priorities (Leah, 8m), 2) Redwood Optimize demo + cost/playbook (Tom, 12m), 3) Data residency policy update (Ben, 6m), 4) Customer launch callouts & wins (Ivy, 6m), 5) Open Q&A (10m). Please add Qs to the intake form: https://forms.redwood/allhands-q. Recording enabled; captions on.
Tom Rivera: Planning to demo a live Optimize run showing batching + quantization tradeoffs. Will need a short clip of 5s of a high-traffic trace from staging. Who can grant access?
Leah Park: @Tom, ping @Ivy for the staging artifact; she owns the demo customer and has the sanitized trace.
Ivy: I can post the sanitized trace and a short note about the context. Will avoid any customer-identifying strings.
Priya Nair: Ben, is the data residency update about EU region defaults? Some of our sales folks are getting questions.
Ben (Legal): Yes 1% change: we'll default Hosted customers in EU to store logs in eu-1 unless they opt-in to global. Dedicated/Private customers can choose. We'll outline the migration plan and timing during the all-hands.
Priya Nair: Will customers be notified directly? Also, any impact on existing contracts?
Ben (Legal): Customers will receive an email + console banner. No change to existing signed contracts; we'll offer migration assistance. We'll share the policy doc after the meeting.
OpsBot: Reminder: submit slides to #deck-submissions by EOD Tue.
Leah Park: Good callouts. Presenters: 3 slides max, 2 min each. Upload to the deck repo: https://repo.redwood/allhands-deck.
Tom Rivera: For the demo, I'll show latency / unit-cost before/after Optimize suggestions and a quick how-to inside Console. Hoping to surface the new "batch suggestion" toggle.
Ivy: Also want a 30s customer highlight: a marketing quote and a short chart on latency improvement. Filing PR for the slide.
Priya Nair: Small request: could we include a 1-line about support windows for Dedicated commits? Sales would like clarity.
Leah Park: Add that under launch callouts please. We'll keep the all-hands tight so we can leave time for Qs.
--after the meeting--
Leah Park: Recording posted: https://video.redwood/recs/2187654321. Captions + transcript: https://video.redwood/recs/2187654321/transcript. TL;DR: exec priorities focused on scale & regions; Optimize rollout guidance + demo; EU data residency default change for Hosted with migration plan; customer win spotlight; action list below.
Tom Rivera: Uploaded demo artifacts: https://repo.redwood/demos/optimize-run-2187654321. Notes: batch toggle preview is behind feature-flag and will ship to beta next week.
Ben (Legal): Posted policy summary + migration timeline: https://docs.redwood/policies/data-residency-eu. FAQ coming by EOD Friday.
Ivy: Customer quote approved and slide assets in the repo.
Leah Park: Actions: 1) Tom to open beta sign-up for Optimize feature (due Fri), 2) Ben to publish full policy + FAQ (due Fri), 3) DevEx to publish a short how-to for Optimize in Console (Ivy + Tom co-author, due Mon), 4) Marketing to prepare the customer win blog draft (Ivy lead, due next Wed). I'll create Asana tasks and tag owners.
Priya Nair: Thanks everyone. Can we get the short TL;DR bullet email to be sent to external partners after marketing review?
Leah Park: Yes, marketing will coordinate. Sending internal follow-ups now. Thanks all! :sparkles:
